name: Forced displacement
summary: About 50,000 fled Ethiopian clashes into Kenya since late October; no new event displacing 500,000 found
state: IOM and partners say about 50,000 people have crossed from Ethiopia into Kenya's Moyale area since late October, fleeing Oromia–Somali regional clashes (UN News, 9 Nov; Al Jazeera, 9 Nov). That is well below the 500,000 Watch line. Searches on 10 Nov found no single new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month; Sudan's displacement crisis is long-running rather than new.
for_you: No new mass displacement event at the Watch scale. UNHCR and IOM publish figures for ongoing crises in Sudan, eastern Congo and Ethiopia.
rubric_hit: No new event displacing over 500,000 in a month; largest new event about 50,000 (Moyale)
